newsitem.title: FRANCE: French customs seize heroin from German car.
newsitem.headline: French customs seize heroin from German car.

text.p: French customs said on Tuesday they had detained a couple after seizing 24.8 kilos (55 lb) of heroin from a German-registered car driving in from Belgium.
The car was driven by a 30-year-old woman accompanied by her two-year-old son. Her husband was following in another car.
The identity and nationality of the couple were not disclosed. A customs statement said they appeared to have been on their way from the Netherlands to Britain.
